heavyseas.opening.line1: April 1912. The Northern Star went down.
heavyseas.opening.line2: This boat went over the side with too many aboard, and water for only days.
heavyseas.opening.line3: Nobody is coming that fast. You decide who lasts.
heavyseas.game.helmsman_picks: Navigation: helmsman %s picks one of %s cards in the rowing stack (/seas navigate <card>).
heavyseas.game.top_card: Navigation: nobody rowed, flipping the top card (/seas navigate).
heavyseas.game.over.landed: Turn %s: the gulls brought a ship. %s made it ashore.
heavyseas.game.over.all_dead: Turn %s: no one is left alive in the boat.
heavyseas.game.no_score_yet: (No scoring this milestone: treasure and love/hate are not modelled yet, so any score would be fake)
heavyseas.command.no_game: No game running in this world. Start one with /seas start.
heavyseas.command.already_running: A game is already running in this world. End it with /seas end.
heavyseas.command.interrupted: The previous game was not saved (it had reached turn %s). Games are not persisted this milestone.
heavyseas.command.dummy_exists: %s is already reserved for a stand-in.
heavyseas.command.not_action: Not the action phase right now.
heavyseas.command.not_navigation: Not the navigation phase right now.
heavyseas.command.swap_self: You cannot swap seats with yourself.
heavyseas.command.cannot_fight: %s is not conscious, so no fight starts — the unconscious cannot refuse.
heavyseas.command.not_in_row_stack: That card is not in the rowing stack: %s
heavyseas.hud.you: You are the %s · health %s/%s · %s · thirst marks %s
heavyseas.hud.your_turn: Your turn (/seas pass | row | swap | fight)
heavyseas.game.provision_begin: Provision phase: the crate starts at the bow, one card each (%s aboard)
heavyseas.game.provision_empty: The provision deck is empty — drawn out for good, so this phase is skipped.
heavyseas.provision.title: Supply Crate
heavyseas.provision.keep_one: Keep one, pass the rest on (%s in the crate)
heavyseas.hand.title: Your Hand
heavyseas.hand.empty: The crate has not reached you yet.
